# Assertion arguments for the tool-name-correction feature-stub-smoke scenario,
# one per line, passed as --assert <scope:pattern:count> plus --backend-requests.
# The invented name must never reach the client wire; the corrected call must.
# Backend bodies are raw JSON, so the correction sentence's quotes match escaped.
wire:invented_tool:0
wire:get_weather:1
backend:Available tools: \"get_weather\":1
log:outcome=corrected reason=unknown_tool_name:1
